traditional: V + 得 + 好有說服力
jyutping: V dak1 hou2 jau5 seoi3 fuk6 lik6

english.note: This is the all-purpose spoken construction for doing or explaining something in a compelling, persuasive way.

examples.english: You explained the matter compellingly, and even I believed you.
examples.traditional: 你將件事講得好有說服力，連我都信你。
examples.jyutping: nei5 zoeng1 gin6 si6 gong2 dak1 hou2 jau5 seoi3 fuk6 lik6 lin4 ngo5 dou1 seon3 nei5
